overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Police and Fire Commission was scheduled to meet to approve previous meeting minutes, receive public comment, and conduct a closed session to interview a Fire Department applicant regarding employment matters.

agenda.item: Closed Session - Consideration of employment, promotion, compensation or performance evaluation data regarding Fire Department applicant interview

discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to approve the minutes from its previous meeting held on August 24, 2026.

discussions.item: Closed Session - Fire Department Applicant Interview
discussions.body: The commission was set to convene in closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statute 19.85(1)(c) to consider employment and performance evaluation matters related to a Fire Department applicant interview. The closed session was scheduled to address personnel matters over which the commission has jurisdiction.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, with a maximum of 15 minutes total and three minutes per person, with time extensions at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: scheduled to approve August 24, 2026 meeting minutes
scheduled to convene in closed session for Fire Department applicant interview
expected to reconvene in open session following closed session
anticipated to take action following closed session deliberations
title: Police and Fire Commission Meeting - 2026-09-28
